segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁנֵי גִיטִּין וּשְׁתֵּי כְתוּבּוֹת, גּוֹבָה שְׁתֵּי כְתוּבּוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If a woman had «two bills of divorce and two marriage contracts» as a result of her divorce and remarriage to the same man, the fact that she is in possession of these documents proves that she was never paid for her first marriage contract, and she «collects two marriage contracts.»

segments.he: שְׁתֵּי כְתוּבּוֹת וְגֵט אֶחָד, אוֹ כְּתוּבָּה וּשְׁנֵי גִטִּין, אוֹ כְּתוּבָּה וְגֵט וּמִיתָה — אֵינָהּ גּוֹבָה אֶלָּא כְּתוּבָּה אַחַת. שֶׁהַמְגָרֵשׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהֶחְזִירָהּ — עַל מְנָת כְּתוּבָּה הָרִאשׁוֹנָה מַחְזִירָהּ.
segments.en: If she was in possession of «two marriage contracts and» only «one bill of divorce; or» if she had one «marriage contract and two bills of divorce; or» if she had «a marriage contract, a bill of divorce, and» witnesses to her husband’s «death» after their remarriage, «she collects» payment of «only one marriage contract.» This is because there is a presumption «that one who divorces his wife and remarries her, remarries her with the intention» of using her «first marriage contract,» and she agrees that she collects payment of only the original document. This is the presumption, unless he wrote another marriage contract for her.

moves.summary: two gets and two ketubot: collects two
other combinations: only one, remarried on the first ketuba

positions.claim: two gets and two ketubot collect two; otherwise only one, since a remarried wife is taken back on the first ketuba

principlesInvoked: המגרש את אשתו והחזירה על מנת כתובה הראשונה מחזירה
